views.name: agency_demographics_dvsv
views.sourceSql:
WITH 
cte_shelter_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,ref.Fiscal_Year AS fiscal_year
,ref.[Quarter]
,MIN(ref.ANL_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,pe.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.VictimType 
,pe.AbuseStatus 
,pe.TANFEligible 
,cp.disability
,cp.race
,cp.multi_race_ind
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.gender
,cp.mil_veteran
,cp.prev_addr_city
,cp.prev_addr_state
,cp.prev_addr_zip
,cp.dob

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND ISNULL(pe.ServiceEndDate, GETDATE()) >= ref.ANL_MStart) 

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
,pe.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.VictimType
,pe.AbuseStatus
,pe.TANFEligible
,cp.disability
,cp.race
,cp.multi_race_ind
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.gender
,cp.mil_veteran
,cp.prev_addr_city
,cp.prev_addr_state
,cp.prev_addr_zip
,cp.dob
),

cte_nonshelter_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,ref.Fiscal_Year AS fiscal_year
,ref.[Quarter]
,MIN(ref.ANL_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVHEART%' THEN 'DVHEART'
END AS [Program_Name]
,pe.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.VictimType 
,pe.AbuseStatus 
,pe.TANFEligible 
,cp.disability
,cp.race
,cp.multi_race_ind
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.gender
,cp.mil_veteran
,cp.prev_addr_city
,cp.prev_addr_state
,cp.prev_addr_zip
,cp.dob

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.ANL_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test' 
		AND (svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVHEART%')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVHEART%' THEN 'DVHEART'
END
,pe.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.VictimType
,pe.AbuseStatus
,pe.TANFEligible
,cp.disability
,cp.race
,cp.multi_race_ind
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.gender
,cp.mil_veteran
,cp.prev_addr_city
,cp.prev_addr_state
,cp.prev_addr_zip
,cp.dob
),

cte_agg_clients AS (
SELECT *
FROM cte_shelter_clients

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM cte_nonshelter_clients
)

SELECT agg.Client_ProfileID
,agg.client_name
,agg.fiscal_year
,MIN(agg.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(agg.MonthServed) AS MonthServed
,agg.[Program_Name]



	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.gender IS NULL OR agg.gender IN('Client doesn''t know','Client refused', 'Data not collected') THEN '4-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN agg.gender='Male' THEN '1-Male'
		WHEN agg.gender='Female' THEN '2-Female'
		ELSE '3-Other' 
	END) AS gender


,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.multi_race_ind = 'No' OR agg.multi_race_ind ='' OR agg.multi_race_ind IS NULL THEN
			CASE
				WHEN agg.race = 'Asian' THEN '1-Asian'
				WHEN agg.race = 'Black or African American' THEN '2-Black or African American'
				WHEN agg.race = 'American Indian or Alaska Native' THEN '3-American Indian or Alaska Native'
				WHEN agg.race = 'Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander' THEN '4-Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander'
				WHEN agg.race = 'White' THEN '5-White'
				WHEN agg.race LIKE '%Client Refused%' OR agg.race LIKE '%Client Doesn''t Know%' OR agg.race LIKE '%Data not collected%' THEN '7-Unknown/Not Reported'
				WHEN agg.race LIKE '%|%' THEN '7-Unknown/Not Reported' 
			END
		WHEN agg.race NOT IN ('Client Refused', 'Client Doesn''t Know', 'Data not collected') AND agg.race IS NOT NULL AND agg.multi_race_ind = 'Yes' THEN '6-Multi-Racial'
		WHEN agg.multi_race_ind = 'Yes' THEN '6-Multi-Racial'
		ELSE '7-Unknown/Not Reported' 
	END) AS race

,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'At or Below 100% of FPL' THEN '1-At or Below 100% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Between 100% and 150% of FPL' THEN '2-Between 100% and 150% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Between 150% and 200% of FPL' THEN '3-Between 150% and 200% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Between 200% and 250% of FPL' THEN '4-Between 200% and 250% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Above 250% of FPL' THEN '5-Above 250% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Unknown/Not Reported' 
			OR agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel IS NULL OR agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel ='' THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		
	END) AS fpl


	,MAX(CASE 
		WHEN agg.ethnicity IN('Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)') THEN '1-Hispanic/Latino'
		WHEN agg.ethnicity IN('Non-Hispanic/Non-Latin(a)(o)(x)') THEN '2-Not Hispanic/Latino'
		WHEN (agg.ethnicity IS NULL OR agg.ethnicity IN('Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client Refused', 'Data not collected')) THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '4-Other' 
	END) AS ethnicity


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.mil_veteran='No' THEN '1-No'
		WHEN agg.mil_veteran='Yes' THEN '2-Yes'
		ELSE '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS veteran_status


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))<=2 THEN '0-0 to 2'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '1-3 to 5'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 6 AND 13 THEN '2-6 to 13'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 14 AND 17 THEN '3-14 to 17'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 18 AND 30 THEN '4-18 to 30'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 31 AND 49 THEN '5-31 to 49'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 50 AND 64 THEN '6-50 to 64'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 65 AND 74 THEN '7-65 to 74'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 75 AND 84 THEN '8-75 to 84'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))>=85 THEN '9-85+'
		ELSE 'z-Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS age_group

	,MAX(agg.prev_addr_city) AS prev_addr_city 
	,MAX(agg.prev_addr_state) AS prev_addr_state 
	,MAX(agg.prev_addr_zip) AS zipcode 


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Avondale','Buckeye','Carefree','Cave Creek','Casa Grande','Chandler','El Mirage','Fountain Hills','Gila Bend','Gilbert','Glendale','Goodyear',
			'Guadalupe','Laveen','Litchfield Park','Mesa','Paradise Valley','Peoria','Phoenix','Queen Creek','Scottsdale','Sun City','Sun City West','Surprise','San Tan Valley','Tempe',
			'Tolleson','Tonopah','Tucson','Wickenburg','Waddell','Youngtown') THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,'1-'+(UPPER(LEFT(agg.prev_addr_city,1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING(agg.prev_addr_city,2,LEN(agg.prev_addr_city)))))
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('A.J','Apache Junction','AJ', 'A.J.') THEN '1-Apache junction' 
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Phx','Phenix','Fenix','Pheonix') THEN '1-Phoenix' 
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Wadel', 'Wadell', 'Waddel') THEN '1-Waddell' 
		WHEN (agg.prev_addr_state='Arizona' OR agg.prev_addr_state='AZ') AND agg.prev_addr_city NOT IN('Avondale','Buckeye','Carefree','Cave Creek','Chandler','El Mirage',
			'Fountain Hills','Gila Bend','Gilbert','Glendale','Goodyear','Guadalupe','Litchfield Park','Mesa','Paradise Valley','Peoria','Phoenix','Queen Creek','Scottsdale',
			'Sun City','Sun City West','Surprise','Tempe','Tolleson','Wickenburg','Youngtown')  THEN '4-Other'
		WHEN (agg.prev_addr_state IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_state ='') AND (agg.prev_addr_city IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_city ='') 
			AND (agg.prev_addr_zip IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip='') THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Unknown', 'NA', 'N/A') AND (agg.prev_addr_state IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_state='') AND (agg.prev_addr_zip IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip='') THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN (agg.prev_addr_city IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_city='') AND (agg.prev_addr_state IN('Unknown', 'NA', 'N/A')) AND (agg.prev_addr_zip IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip='') THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN ((agg.prev_addr_state!='Arizona' OR agg.prev_addr_state!='AZ') AND (agg.prev_addr_city IS NOT NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip IS NOT NULL)) THEN '5-Out of State'
		ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,agg.prev_addr_city + ', ' + agg.prev_addr_state + ' ' + agg.prev_addr_zip)
	END) AS residence


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims With Disabilities%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims With Disabilities%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS disability


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS lgbtq


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS deaf_hoh


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN (agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Homeless%' OR agg.VictimType LIKE '%Homeless%') AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%'  THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN (agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Homeless%' OR agg.VictimType LIKE '%Homeless%') AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS homeless


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Limited English Proficiency%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Limited English Proficiency%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS lep


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Immigrants/Refugees/Asylum Seekers%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Immigrants/Refugees/Asylum Seekers%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS imm_ref_asy


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Domestic Violence%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS dv_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Assault%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS sa_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Stalking%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS stalk_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Labor Trafficked%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS labor_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sex Trafficked%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS st_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Survivor of Child SA%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS adultsurvivor_childsa_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%|Child SA%' OR agg.VictimType = 'Child SA' THEN '2-Yes' 
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS childsa_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Harassment%' THEN '2-Yes' 
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS harass_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%DV Prevention%' THEN '2-Yes' 
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS dvprevent_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Elder Abuse/Neglect/Exploitation%' THEN '2-Yes' 
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS elder_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.TANFEligible = 'Yes' THEN '2-Yes' 
		WHEN agg.TANFEligible IS NULL OR agg.TANFEligible = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' 
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS tanf


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.AbuseStatus = 'Secondary Victim' THEN '2-Secondary Victim' 
		WHEN agg.AbuseStatus IS NULL OR agg.AbuseStatus = '' OR agg.AbuseStatus = 'Other' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' 
		ELSE '1-Primary Victim'
	END) AS abusestatus

FROM cte_agg_clients agg



GROUP BY agg.Client_ProfileID
,agg.client_name
,agg.fiscal_year
,agg.[Program_Name]

		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Between 200% and 250% of FPL' THEN '4-Between 200% and 250% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Above 250% of FPL' THEN '5-Above 250% of FPL'
		WHEN agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel = 'Unknown/Not Reported' 
			OR agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel IS NULL OR agg.HouseholdReportedIncomeLevel ='' THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		
	END) AS fpl


	,MAX(CASE 
		WHEN agg.ethnicity IN('Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)') THEN '1-Hispanic/Latino'
		WHEN agg.ethnicity IN('Non-Hispanic/Non-Latin(a)(o)(x)') THEN '2-Not Hispanic/Latino'
		WHEN (agg.ethnicity IS NULL OR agg.ethnicity IN('Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client Refused', 'Data not collected')) THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '4-Other' 
	END) AS ethnicity


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.mil_veteran='No' THEN '1-No'
		WHEN agg.mil_veteran='Yes' THEN '2-Yes'
		ELSE '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS veteran_status

		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))<=2 THEN '0-0 to 2'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '1-3 to 5'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 6 AND 13 THEN '2-6 to 13'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 14 AND 17 THEN '3-14 to 17'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 18 AND 30 THEN '4-18 to 30'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 31 AND 49 THEN '5-31 to 49'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 50 AND 64 THEN '6-50 to 64'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 65 AND 74 THEN '7-65 to 74'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 75 AND 84 THEN '8-75 to 84'
		WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, agg.dob),CAST(agg.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))>=85 THEN '9-85+'
		ELSE 'z-Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS age_group

	,MAX(agg.prev_addr_city) AS prev_addr_city 
	,MAX(agg.prev_addr_state) AS prev_addr_state 
	,MAX(agg.prev_addr_zip) AS zipcode 


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Avondale','Buckeye','Carefree','Cave Creek','Casa Grande','Chandler','El Mirage','Fountain Hills','Gila Bend','Gilbert','Glendale','Goodyear',
			'Guadalupe','Laveen','Litchfield Park','Mesa','Paradise Valley','Peoria','Phoenix','Queen Creek','Scottsdale','Sun City','Sun City West','Surprise','San Tan Valley','Tempe',
			'Tolleson','Tonopah','Tucson','Wickenburg','Waddell','Youngtown') THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,'1-'+(UPPER(LEFT(agg.prev_addr_city,1))+LOWER(SUBSTRING(agg.prev_addr_city,2,LEN(agg.prev_addr_city)))))
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('A.J','Apache Junction','AJ', 'A.J.') THEN '1-Apache junction' 
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Phx','Phenix','Fenix','Pheonix') THEN '1-Phoenix' 
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Wadel', 'Wadell', 'Waddel') THEN '1-Waddell' 
		WHEN (agg.prev_addr_state='Arizona' OR agg.prev_addr_state='AZ') AND agg.prev_addr_city NOT IN('Avondale','Buckeye','Carefree','Cave Creek','Chandler','El Mirage',
			'Fountain Hills','Gila Bend','Gilbert','Glendale','Goodyear','Guadalupe','Litchfield Park','Mesa','Paradise Valley','Peoria','Phoenix','Queen Creek','Scottsdale',
			'Sun City','Sun City West','Surprise','Tempe','Tolleson','Wickenburg','Youngtown')  THEN '4-Other'
		WHEN (agg.prev_addr_state IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_state ='') AND (agg.prev_addr_city IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_city ='') 
			AND (agg.prev_addr_zip IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip='') THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN agg.prev_addr_city IN('Unknown', 'NA', 'N/A') AND (agg.prev_addr_state IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_state='') AND (agg.prev_addr_zip IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip='') THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN (agg.prev_addr_city IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_city='') AND (agg.prev_addr_state IN('Unknown', 'NA', 'N/A')) AND (agg.prev_addr_zip IS NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip='') THEN '6-Unknown/Not Reported'
		WHEN ((agg.prev_addr_state!='Arizona' OR agg.prev_addr_state!='AZ') AND (agg.prev_addr_city IS NOT NULL OR agg.prev_addr_zip IS NOT NULL)) THEN '5-Out of State'
		ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR,agg.prev_addr_city + ', ' + agg.prev_addr_state + ' ' + agg.prev_addr_zip)
	END) AS residence


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims With Disabilities%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims With Disabilities%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS disability


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS lgbtq


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS deaf_hoh

		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Limited English Proficiency%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS lep


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Immigrants/Refugees/Asylum Seekers%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Immigrants/Refugees/Asylum Seekers%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS imm_ref_asy


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Domestic Violence%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS dv_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Assault%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS sa_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Stalking%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS stalk_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Labor Trafficked%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS labor_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sex Trafficked%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS st_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Survivor of Child SA%' THEN '2-Yes'
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'
	END) AS adultsurvivor_childsa_vic


	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%|Child SA%' OR agg.VictimType = 'Child SA' THEN '2-Yes' 
		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE '1-No'

	,MAX(CASE

		WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported'

		WHEN agg.AbuseStatus = 'Secondary Victim' THEN '2-Secondary Victim'

'%Homeless%' OR agg.VictimType LIKE '%Homeless%') AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS homeless, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Limited English Proficiency%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Limited English Proficiency%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS lep, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Immigrants/Refugees/Asylum Seekers%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Immigrants/Refugees/Asylum Seekers%' AND agg.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%None%' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS imm_ref_asy, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Domestic Violence%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS dv_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Assault%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS sa_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Stalking%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS stalk_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Labor Trafficked%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS labor_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sex Trafficked%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS st_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Survivor of Child SA%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS adultsurvivor_childsa_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%|Child SA%' OR agg.VictimType = 'Child SA' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS childsa_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Harassment%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS harass_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%DV Prevention%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS dvprevent_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.VictimType LIKE '%Elder Abuse/Neglect/Exploitation%' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.VictimType IS NULL OR agg.VictimType = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS elder_vic, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.TANFEligible = 'Yes' THEN '2-Yes' WHEN agg.TANFEligible IS NULL OR agg.TANFEligible = '' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-No' END) AS tanf, MAX(CASE WHEN agg.AbuseStatus = 'Secondary Victim' THEN '2-Secondary Victim' WHEN agg.AbuseStatus IS NULL OR agg.AbuseStatus = '' OR agg.AbuseStatus = 'Other' THEN '3-Unknown/Not Reported' ELSE '1-Primary Victim' END) AS abusestatus FROM cte_agg_clients AS agg GROUP BY agg.Client_ProfileID, agg.client_name, agg.fiscal_year, agg."Program_Name"

WITH
cte_shelter_bednights AS (
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CAST(CASE
	
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House' 
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House Transitional' 
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Outreach') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach' 
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name] 
,pe.ClientType
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CAST(bed.CheckInDate AS DATE) AS CheckInDate
,CAST(bed.CheckOutDate AS DATE) AS CheckOutDate
,pe.DischargeStatus
,pe.ExitDestination

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN BedEnrollment bed ON bed.RecordID=LinkFromId


WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'

	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Outreach') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END
,pe.ClientType
,bed.CheckInDate
,bed.CheckOutDate
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.DischargeStatus
,pe.ExitDestination
)

views.name: calls
views.sourceSql:
WITH 


cte_FirstCall AS ( 
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,MIN(CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)) AS first_call_date

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
    JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
    JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
    AND (pe.[Program] = 'SV Helpline' 
		OR pe.ProgramType = 'Hotline')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
),


cte_FirstHelplineCall AS (
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,MIN(CAST(h.DateOfContact AS DATE)) AS first_call_date

FROM Client_Profile cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id
	JOIN Helpline h ON h.RecordID = docs.RecordId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
),


cte_svHelpline AS (
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CAST(cp.dob AS DATE) AS DOB
,cp.race
,cp.gender
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.multi_race_ind AS MultiRaceInd
,cp.mil_veteran AS VeteranStatus
,CASE
    WHEN pe.[Program] = 'SV Helpline' THEN 'SV Helpline Call'
END AS [Program_Name]
,fc.first_call_date
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS Call_Date
,pe.ClientType
,pe.AbuseStatus
,pe.VictimType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.RecordID AS pe_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
JOIN cte_FirstCall fc ON fc.Client_ProfileID = cp.document_id

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
AND pe.[Program] = 'SV Helpline'
),


cte_dvHotline AS (
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CAST(cp.dob AS DATE) AS DOB
,cp.race
,cp.gender
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.multi_race_ind AS MultiRaceInd
,cp.mil_veteran AS VeteranStatus
,CASE
    WHEN pe.[ProgramType] = 'Hotline' THEN 'Other/Hotline Call'
END AS [Program_Name]
,fc.first_call_date
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS Call_Date
,pe.ClientType
,pe.AbuseStatus
,pe.VictimType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.RecordID AS pe_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
JOIN cte_FirstCall fc ON fc.Client_ProfileID = cp.document_id

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
AND pe.[ProgramType] = 'Hotline'
),


cte_PhoneLog AS (
SELECT ph.document_id AS Client_ProfileID 
,ph.CallerNameOrInitials AS client_name
,NULL AS DOB
,'Data not collected' AS race
,'Data not collected' AS gender
,'Data not collected' AS ethnicity
,'No' AS MultiRaceInd
,'Data not collected' AS VeteranStatus
,CASE
	WHEN ph.[Program] IS NOT NULL THEN ph.[Program] + ' Phone Log Call'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(ph.DateofContact AS DATE) AS first_call_date 
,CAST(ph.DateofContact AS DATE) AS Call_Date
,'Unknown' AS ClientType
,ph.AbuseStatus
,ph.VictimType 
,ph.ClientSpecialClassification
,NULL AS pe_RecordID 

FROM PhoneLog ph
),


cte_Helpline AS (
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CAST(cp.dob AS DATE) AS DOB
,cp.race
,cp.gender
,cp.ethnicity
,cp.multi_race_ind AS MultiRaceInd
,cp.mil_veteran AS VeteranStatus
,CASE
	WHEN h.[Program] IS NOT NULL THEN h.[Program] + ' DVHelpline Call'
END AS [Program_Name]
,fc.first_call_date
,CAST(h.DateOfContact AS DATE) AS Call_Date
,'Unknown' AS ClientType
,'Unknown' AS AbuseStatus
,'Unknown' AS VictimType
,'Unknown' AS ClientSpecialClassification
,NULL AS pe_RecordID 

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
JOIN Helpline h ON h.RecordID=docs.RecordId
JOIN cte_FirstHelplineCall fc ON fc.Client_ProfileID = cp.document_id

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
),


cte_agg_Calls AS (
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM cte_svHelpline
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_dvHotline
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_PhoneLog
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_Helpline
)

SELECT *
FROM cte_agg_Calls
views.adaptedSourceSql: SELECT COALESCE(cp.document_id,h.RecordID) AS Client_ProfileID, COALESCE(cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name,'Anonymous caller') AS client_name, cp.first_name AS First_Name, cp.last_name AS Last_Name, CAST(cp.dob AS DATE) AS DOB, cp.race, cp.gender, cp.ethnicity, cp.multi_race_ind AS MultiRaceInd, cp.mil_veteran AS VeteranStatus, CASE WHEN h.Program = 'SV Helpline' THEN 'SV Helpline Call' ELSE h.Program + ' DVHelpline Call' END AS Program_Name, MIN(CAST(h.DateOfContact AS DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(cp.document_id,h.RecordID)) AS first_call_date, CAST(h.DateOfContact AS DATE) AS Call_Date, CASE WHEN cp.dob IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN cp.dob > DATEADD(YEAR,-18,CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) THEN 'Child' ELSE 'Adult' END AS ClientType, h.AbuseStatus, 'Unknown' AS VictimType, 'Unknown' AS ClientSpecialClassification, NULL AS pe_RecordID, h.RecordID AS call_record_id FROM Helpline h LEFT JOIN documents docs ON docs.RecordId=h.RecordID LEFT JOIN Client_Profile cp ON cp.document_id=docs.ParentId WHERE cp.last_name <> 'Test' OR cp.last_name IS NULL

views.name: des_dv_01_clients
views.sourceSql:
WITH 
cte_shelter_clients AS ( 
SELECT DiSTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CAST(CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)) AS first_service
,MIN(CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)) AS ServiceStartDate
,MAX(CASE
    WHEN pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL THEN CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
    ELSE CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE)
END) AS ServiceEndDate
,pe.RecordID AS T2_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON ((pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND (pe.ServiceEndDate >= ref.State_MStart OR (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND GETDATE() >= ref.State_MStart))) OR (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND pe.ServiceStartDate >=ref.State_MStart))

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,pe.Program
,CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
,pe.RecordID
),

cte_mcba_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS T2_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.State_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.State_MStart) 

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID
),

cte_agg_clients AS (
SELECT *
FROM cte_shelter_clients cs

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM cte_mcba_clients mcba
),
RankedData AS (
SELECT agg.Client_ProfileID
,agg.Fiscal_Year
,agg.[Quarter]
,agg.MonthServed
,agg.[Program_Name]
,agg.first_service
,agg.ServiceStartDate
,agg.ServiceEndDate
,agg.T2_RecordID
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

WITH
cte_shelter_nonsvcs AS   

(SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CAST(CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CASE
    WHEN pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL THEN 
        CASE
            WHEN (MONTH(GETDATE()) > 10 OR (MONTH(GETDATE()) = 10 AND DAY(GETDATE()) >= 1)) AND pe.ServiceStartDate < CAST(CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR) + '-10-01' AS DATE) THEN 
                CAST(CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR) + '-10-01' AS DATE)
            ELSE 
                CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
        END
    ELSE 
        CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE)
END AS ServiceEndDate
,pe.RecordID AS T2_RecordID

,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND pe.TANFEligible = 'Yes' THEN '1-TANF Adult'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND pe.TANFEligible = 'Yes' THEN '2-TANF Child'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND pe.TANFEligible IN ('No', 'N/A', '') THEN '3-non-TANF Adult'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND pe.TANFEligible IN ('No', 'N/A', '') THEN '4-non-TANF Child'
END AS TANF_Status

,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.EnrollmentStatus = 'Turnaway' AND pe.ReasonTurnedAway LIKE '%Capacity%' THEN '1-No Room'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.EnrollmentStatus = 'Turnaway' AND pe.ReasonTurnedAway = 'No Show' THEN '2-No Show'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.EnrollmentStatus = 'Turnaway' AND (pe.ReasonTurnedAway != 'No Show' OR pe.ReasonTurnedAway NOT LIKE '%Capacity%' OR pe.ReasonTurnedAway IS NULL) THEN '3-Other Reasons'
END AS Turnaway_Status


,CASE
    WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') 
        AND pe.ServiceEndDate IS NOT NULL THEN '1-Exited'
END AS Exit_Status


,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') 
		AND pe.SafeLoc IN ('Yes')
		AND pe.ServiceEndDate IS NOT NULL THEN '1-Safe/Stable Location'
END AS Safe_Location

FROM Client_Profile cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON ((pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND pe.ServiceEndDate >= ref.State_MStart) OR (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND pe.ServiceStartDate >=ref.State_MStart AND (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL OR pe.ServiceEndDate = '')))

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,pe.Program
,CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
,pe.RecordID
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType

,pe.ReasonTurnedAway
,pe.SafeLoc
,pe.EnrollmentStatus

WITH
cte_mcba_hours AS (

SELECT *
FROM
	(SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,ref.Fiscal_Year

						PARTITION BY cp.document_id, ref.Fiscal_Year, svcs.RecordID

	END
	,pe.ServiceStartDate
	,pe.ServiceEndDate
	,svcs.RecordID
	,svcs.InHours

)

views.name: des_dv_quarterly_02_data
views.sourceSql:
WITH
cte_shelter_nonSvcs AS   

(SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CAST(CASE
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)) AS first_service
,MIN(CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)) AS ServiceStartDate
,MAX(CASE
    WHEN pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL THEN CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
    ELSE CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE)
END) AS ServiceEndDate
,pe.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Female' THEN '1-Adult Female'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Male' THEN '2-Adult Male'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender LIKE 'A gender other than singularly female or male%' THEN '3-Adult Non-binary'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender IN ('Transgender', 'Questioning', 'Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client refused', 'Data not collected') THEN '4-Not Specified/Other'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Unknown' THEN '4-Not Specified/Other' 
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Gender
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '2-Child'
END AS Client_Type
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' THEN '1-Self-Identified as LGBTQ'
END AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND (CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17) 
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Current or Former Dating Relationship%' THEN '1-Youth Victim of Dating Violence'
END AS Youth_Dating_Violence
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House')
		AND (pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%'
			OR pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Disabilities: Cognitive/Physical/Mental%') THEN '1-Self-Identified as Disabled'
END AS Disabled_SelfID

,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House', 'DVSTOP', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House') AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived = 'Yes' THEN '1-Received Disability Accommodations'
END AS Disability_Assist

FROM Client_Profile cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	LEFT JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	LEFT JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON ((pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND (pe.ServiceEndDate >= ref.State_MStart OR (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND GETDATE() >= ref.State_MStart))) OR (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND pe.ServiceStartDate >=ref.State_MStart))

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,pe.Program
,pe.ProjectType
,pe.RecordID
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser


,pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived
),

cte_mcba_nonSvcs AS

(SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Female' THEN '1-Adult Female'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Male' THEN '2-Adult Male'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender LIKE 'A gender other than singularly female or male%' THEN '3-Adult Non-binary'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender IN ('Transgender', 'Questioning', 'Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client refused', 'Data not collected') THEN '4-Not Specified/Other'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Unknown' THEN '4-Not Specified/Other' 
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Gender
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '2-Child'
END AS Client_Type
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' THEN '1-Self-Identified as LGBTQ'
END AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND (CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17) 
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser IN('Current or Former Dating Relationship') THEN '1-Youth Victim of Dating Violence'
END AS Youth_Dating_Violence
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%'
		AND (pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%'
			OR pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Disabilities: Cognitive/Physical/Mental%') THEN '1-Self-Identified as Disabled'
END AS Disabled_SelfID

,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived = 'Yes' THEN '1-Received Disability Accommodations'
END AS Disability_Assist

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.State_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.State_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser


,pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived
,svcs.RecordID
,svcs.ProgramEnrollment
,svcs.DateofService
),

cte_Svcs AS (

SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Interpretation') THEN '1-Received Interpretation'
	END) AS Lang_Svcs
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '1-Child/Youth Received Crisis Intervention'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention'
		END) AS Crisis_Intervention
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '1-Child/Youth Received Victim Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '2-Adult Received Victim Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '3-Unknown Received Victim Advocacy'
		END) AS Victim_Advocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '1-Child/Youth Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
		END) AS Counseling_andGroups
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS MedAdv
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation'
		END) AS Tspt
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('External Referral') THEN '1-Adult Received External Referral'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('External Referral') THEN '2-Unknown Received Received External Referral'
		END) AS ExtnlRef
	,svcs.DateofService

	FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	
	WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'

	GROUP BY cp.document_id, svcs.DateofService
),

cte_agg_nonSvcs AS (

SELECT *
FROM cte_shelter_nonSvcs

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM cte_mcba_nonSvcs
)

SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity

,CASE
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))<=12 THEN '1-0 to 12'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17 THEN '2-13 to 17'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '3-18 to 24'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 25 AND 54 THEN '4-25 to 49'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 55 AND 59 THEN '5-50 to 59'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))>=60 THEN '6-60+'
	WHEN MAX(aggns.Client_Type) = '1-Adult' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '7-Unknown Adult Age'
	WHEN MAX(aggns.Client_Type) = '2-Child' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '8-Unknown Child Age'
	ELSE '9-Unknown/Not Reported' 
END AS Age_Group
,MAX(aggns.Gender) AS Gender
,MAX(aggns.Client_Type) AS Client_Type
,MAX(aggns.Disabled_SelfID) AS Disabled_SelfID
,MAX(aggns.LGBTQ_SelfID) AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,MAX(aggns.Youth_Dating_Violence) AS Youth_Dating_Violence

,MAX(aggns.Disability_Assist) AS Disability_Assist
,CAST(s.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,s.Lang_Svcs AS Lang_Svcs
,s.Crisis_Intervention AS Crisis_Intervention
,s.Victim_Advocacy AS Victim_Advocacy
,s.Counseling_andGroups AS Counseling_andGroups
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.MedAdv AS Medical_Advocacy
,s.Tspt AS Transportation
,s.ExtnlRef AS External_Referral

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	INNER JOIN dv.vw_DES_DV_01_clients cs ON cp.document_id=cs.Client_ProfileID
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_agg_nonSvcs aggns ON (aggns.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_Svcs s ON (s.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,cp.dob
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,s.DateofService
,s.Lang_Svcs
,s.Crisis_Intervention
,s.Victim_Advocacy
,s.Counseling_andGroups
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.MedAdv
,s.Tspt
,s.ExtnlRef

	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON ((pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND (pe.ServiceEndDate >= ref.State_MStart OR (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND GETDATE() >= ref.State_MStart))) OR (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND pe.ServiceStartDate >=ref.State_MStart))

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,pe.Program
,pe.ProjectType
,pe.RecordID
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser


,pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived
),

cte_mcba_nonSvcs AS

(SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Female' THEN '1-Adult Female'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Male' THEN '2-Adult Male'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender LIKE 'A gender other than singularly female or male%' THEN '3-Adult Non-binary'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender IN ('Transgender', 'Questioning', 'Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client refused', 'Data not collected') THEN '4-Not Specified/Other'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Unknown' THEN '4-Not Specified/Other' 
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Gender
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '2-Child'
END AS Client_Type
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' THEN '1-Self-Identified as LGBTQ'
END AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND (CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17) 
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser IN('Current or Former Dating Relationship') THEN '1-Youth Victim of Dating Violence'
END AS Youth_Dating_Violence
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%'
		AND (pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%'
			OR pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Disabilities: Cognitive/Physical/Mental%') THEN '1-Self-Identified as Disabled'
END AS Disabled_SelfID

,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived = 'Yes' THEN '1-Received Disability Accommodations'
END AS Disability_Assist

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.State_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.State_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser


,pe.DisabilityAccommodationsReceived
,svcs.RecordID
,svcs.ProgramEnrollment
,svcs.DateofService
),

cte_Svcs AS (

SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,MAX(CASE
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Interpretation') THEN '1-Received Interpretation'
	END) AS Lang_Svcs
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '1-Child/Youth Received Crisis Intervention'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention'
		END) AS Crisis_Intervention
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '1-Child/Youth Received Victim Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '2-Adult Received Victim Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '3-Unknown Received Victim Advocacy'
		END) AS Victim_Advocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '1-Child/Youth Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
		END) AS Counseling_andGroups
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS MedAdv
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation'
		END) AS Tspt
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('External Referral') THEN '1-Adult Received External Referral'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('External Referral') THEN '2-Unknown Received Received External Referral'
		END) AS ExtnlRef
	,svcs.DateofService

	FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	
	WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'

	GROUP BY cp.document_id, svcs.DateofService
),

cte_agg_nonSvcs AS (

SELECT *
FROM cte_shelter_nonSvcs

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM cte_mcba_nonSvcs
)

SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity

,CASE
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))<=12 THEN '1-0 to 12'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17 THEN '2-13 to 17'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '3-18 to 24'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 25 AND 54 THEN '4-25 to 49'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 55 AND 59 THEN '5-50 to 59'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))>=60 THEN '6-60+'
	WHEN MAX(aggns.Client_Type) = '1-Adult' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '7-Unknown Adult Age'
	WHEN MAX(aggns.Client_Type) = '2-Child' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '8-Unknown Child Age'
	ELSE '9-Unknown/Not Reported' 
END AS Age_Group
,MAX(aggns.Gender) AS Gender
,MAX(aggns.Client_Type) AS Client_Type
,MAX(aggns.Disabled_SelfID) AS Disabled_SelfID
,MAX(aggns.LGBTQ_SelfID) AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,MAX(aggns.Youth_Dating_Violence) AS Youth_Dating_Violence

,MAX(aggns.Disability_Assist) AS Disability_Assist
,CAST(s.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,s.Lang_Svcs AS Lang_Svcs
,s.Crisis_Intervention AS Crisis_Intervention
,s.Victim_Advocacy AS Victim_Advocacy
,s.Counseling_andGroups AS Counseling_andGroups
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.MedAdv AS Medical_Advocacy
,s.Tspt AS Transportation
,s.ExtnlRef AS External_Referral

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	INNER JOIN dv.vw_DES_DV_01_clients cs ON cp.document_id=cs.Client_ProfileID
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_agg_nonSvcs aggns ON (aggns.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_Svcs s ON (s.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,cp.dob
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,s.DateofService
,s.Lang_Svcs
,s.Crisis_Intervention
,s.Victim_Advocacy
,s.Counseling_andGroups
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.MedAdv
,s.Tspt
,s.ExtnlRef

views.name: des_dv_quarterly_02_svcs
views.sourceSql:
WITH

cte_Svcs AS (

SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
	,CAST(CASE
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
	,CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '1-Child/Youth Received Crisis Intervention'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention'
		END) AS Crisis_Intervention
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '1-Child/Youth Received Victim Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '2-Adult Received Victim Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND (svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy', 'External Referral') OR svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning%') THEN '3-Unknown Received Victim Advocacy'
		END) AS Victim_Advocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Child' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '1-Child/Youth Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling', 'Groups') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling and/or Groups'
		END) AS Counseling_andGroups
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS MedAdv
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation'
		END) AS Tspt
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('External Referral') THEN '1-Adult Received External Referral'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('External Referral') THEN '2-Unknown Received Received External Referral'
		END) AS ExtnlRef

	FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	
	WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	
		AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'SVSASS%'
		AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'DVHEART%'
		AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'REACH Center%'

	GROUP BY cp.document_id
	,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
	,CASE
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	END
	,svcs.DateofService
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM cte_Svcs s

WHERE (s.Crisis_Intervention IS NOT NULL OR s.Victim_Advocacy IS NOT NULL 
		OR s.Counseling_andGroups IS NOT NULL OR s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy IS NOT NULL 
		OR s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy IS NOT NULL OR s.MedAdv IS NOT NULL OR s.Tspt IS NOT NULL
		OR s.ExtnlRef IS NOT NULL)

WITH 
cte_sv_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.ANL_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS T2_RecordID

	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.ANL_MStart) 

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND (cp.dob <= DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
			OR pe.ClientType != 'Child')
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID
),

,sv.[Quarter]
,sv.MonthServed
,sv.[Program_Name]
,sv.first_service

,sv.ServiceEndDate
,sv.T2_RecordID
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

,rd.[Program_Name]
