views.name: des_sv_02_svcs
views.sourceSql:
WITH

cte_Svcs AS (

SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
	,CASE
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	END AS [Program_Name]
	,CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService

	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy') THEN '2-Adult Received General Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy') THEN '3-Unknown Received General Advocacy'
		END) AS GenAdv


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS MedAdv


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '2-Adult Attended SA Specific Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '3-Unknown Attended SA Specific Groups'
		END) AS Groups


	,MAX(CASE
		
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention'
	END) AS Crisis_Intervention


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling'
		END) AS Counseling


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Holistic Healing'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Holistic Healing'
		END) AS Healing


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Culturally Specific Healing'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Culturally Specific Healing'
		END) AS CultureSpecHealing


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '1-Adult Received Financial Assistance'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '2-Unknown Received Financial Assistance'
		END) AS FinAssist


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation'
		END) AS Tspt


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' 
				AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' 
				AND svcs.[Service] NOT IN ('Transportation','Emergency Financial Assistance','Culturally Specific Healing','Restorative Yoga','Sound Healing',
											'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment','Group Counseling','Individual Counseling','Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment','Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment',
											'Crisis Intervention','Art of Healing Workshop','LGBTQ+','RISE','Secondary Survivor','General Advocacy', 'Interpretation')
				THEN '2-Adult Received Other Services'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' 
				AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult')
				AND svcs.[Service] NOT IN ('Transportation','Emergency Financial Assistance','Culturally Specific Healing','Restorative Yoga','Sound Healing',
											'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment','Group Counseling','Individual Counseling','Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment','Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment',
											'Crisis Intervention','Art of Healing Workshop','LGBTQ+','RISE','Secondary Survivor','General Advocacy', 'Interpretation')
				THEN '3-Unknown Received Other Services'
		END) AS OthSvcs

	FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	
	WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
		AND (cp.dob <= DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
			OR pe.ClientType != 'Child')
	GROUP BY cp.document_id
	,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
	,CASE
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	END
	,svcs.DateofService
)

WHERE [Program_Name] = 'REACH Center' 
	AND (s.GenAdv IS NOT NULL OR s.MedAdv IS NOT NULL 
		OR s.Groups IS NOT NULL OR s.Crisis_Intervention IS NOT NULL

		OR s.Counseling IS NOT NULL OR s.Healing IS NOT NULL

svcs."Service" IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '2-Adult Attended SA Specific Groups' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '3-Unknown Attended SA Specific Groups' END) AS Groups, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention' END) AS Crisis_Intervention, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment' END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment' END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."ServiceCategory" IN ('Counseling') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."ServiceCategory" IN ('Counseling') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling' END) AS Counseling, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Holistic Healing' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Holistic Healing' END) AS Healing, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Culturally Specific Healing' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Culturally Specific Healing' END) AS CultureSpecHealing, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '1-Adult Received Financial Assistance' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '2-Unknown Received Financial Assistance' END) AS FinAssist, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs."Service" IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs."Service" IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation' END) AS Tspt, MAX(CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND NOT svcs."Service" IN ('Transportation', 'Emergency Financial Assistance', 'Culturally Specific Healing', 'Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing', 'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Group Counseling', 'Individual Counseling', 'Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Crisis Intervention', 'Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor', 'General Advocacy', 'Interpretation') THEN '2-Adult Received Other Services' WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND NOT pe.ClientType IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND NOT svcs."Service" IN ('Transportation', 'Emergency Financial Assistance', 'Culturally Specific Healing', 'Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing', 'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Group Counseling', 'Individual Counseling', 'Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Crisis Intervention', 'Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor', 'General Advocacy', 'Interpretation') THEN '3-Unknown Received Other Services' END) AS OthSvcs FROM base_Client_Profile AS cp JOIN base_documents AS docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id JOIN base_ProgramEnrollment AS pe ON pe.RecordID = docs.RecordId JOIN base_Links AS link ON link.LinkToId = docs.RecordId JOIN base_Services AS svcs ON svcs.RecordID = LinkFromId WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test' AND (cp.dob <= CAST(REPORT_ASOF() AS DATE) + INTERVAL (-18) YEAR OR pe.ClientType <> 'Child') GROUP BY cp.document_id, cp.first_name || ' ' || cp.last_name, CASE WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center' END, svcs.DateofService) SELECT DISTINCT * FROM cte_Svcs AS s WHERE "Program_Name" = 'REACH Center' AND (NOT s.GenAdv IS NULL OR NOT s.MedAdv IS NULL OR NOT s.Groups IS NULL OR NOT s.Crisis_Intervention IS NULL OR NOT s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy IS NULL OR NOT s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy IS NULL OR NOT s.Counseling IS NULL OR NOT s.Healing IS NULL OR NOT s.CultureSpecHealing IS NULL OR NOT s.FinAssist IS NULL OR NOT s.Tspt IS NULL OR NOT s.OthSvcs IS NULL)

views.name: des_sv_quarterly_02_data
views.sourceSql:
WITH
cte_sv_nonSvcs AS

(SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.ANL_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Female' THEN '1-Adult Female'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Male' THEN '2-Adult Male'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender LIKE 'A gender other than singularly female or male%' THEN '3-Adult Non-binary'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender IN ('Transgender', 'Questioning', 'Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client refused', 'Data not collected') THEN '4-Not Specified/Other'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Unknown' THEN '4-Not Specified/Other' 
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Gender
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Client_Type
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' THEN '1-Self-Identified as LGBTQ'
END AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND (pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%'
			OR pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Disabilities: Cognitive/Physical/Mental%') THEN '1-Self-Identified as Disabled'
END AS Disabled_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult'
		AND (pe.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Assault%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Harassment%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Sex Trafficked%') THEN '1-Adult Victim of SA and/or SV'
END AS Vic_AdultSA
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult'
		AND pe.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Survivor of Child SA%' OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Victim of Child SA%' THEN '1-Adult Victim of Childhood SA and/or SV'
END AS Vic_ChildhoodSA
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult', 'Unknown')
		AND pe.AbuseStatus = 'Secondary Victim' THEN '1-Secondary Survivor'
END AS Secondary_Survivor
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult', 'Unknown')
		AND (pe.VictimType LIKE '%Stalking%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Domestic Violence%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Child SA%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Labor Trafficked%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Homeless%'
			OR pe.VictimType IN ('Other')
			OR pe.VictimType IS NULL) THEN '1-Other Victimization'
END AS Vic_Oth
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Current or Former Spouse or Intimate Partner%' THEN '1-Current or Former Partner'
END AS Rel_Partner
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Other Family or Household Member%' THEN '1-Other Family or Household Member'
END AS Rel_Family
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Current or Former Dating Relationship%' THEN '1-Current or Former Dating Relationship'
END AS Rel_Dating
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Acquaintance%' THEN '1-Acquaintance'
END AS Rel_Acq
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Stranger%' THEN '1-Stranger'
END AS Rel_Stranger
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND (pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Relationship Unknown%' 
			OR pe.RelationshiptoAbuser IN ('Other')
			OR pe.RelationshiptoAbuser NOT IN ('Current or Former Spouse or Intimate Partner', 'Other Family or Household Member', 'Current or Former Dating Relationship', 'Acquaintance', 'Stranger')
			OR pe.RelationshiptoAbuser IS NULL) THEN '1-Unknown/Other'
END AS Rel_UnrOth
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Social Media', 'Agency Website') THEN '1-Internet/Website'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Family/Friend') THEN '2-Family/Friend/Acquaintance'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Social Services', 'Family Advocacy Center') THEN '3-Social Service Agency'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Police Department', 'Prosecutor/Attorney') THEN '4-Criminal Justice Agency'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Medical', 'Mental Health', 'Medical Advocacy') THEN '5-Medical/Healthcare Provider'
	ELSE '6-Unknown/Other'
END AS ReferralSource

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.ANL_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND (cp.dob <= DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
			OR pe.ClientType != 'Child')
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.VictimType
,pe.AbuseStatus
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser
,pe.EnrollmentStatus
,pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus
,svcs.RecordID
,svcs.ProgramEnrollment
,svcs.DateofService
),

cte_Svcs AS (

SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,svcs.DateofService
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Interpretation') THEN '1-Received Interpretation'
		END) AS Lang_Svcs


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy') THEN '2-Adult Received General Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy') THEN '3-Unknown Received General Advocacy'
		END) AS GenAdv


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS MedAdv


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '2-Adult Attended SA Specific Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '3-Unknown Attended SA Specific Groups'
		END) AS Groups


	,MAX(CASE
		
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention'
	END) AS Crisis_Intervention


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling'
		END) AS Counseling


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Holistic Healing'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Holistic Healing'
		END) AS Healing


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Culturally Specific Healing'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Culturally Specific Healing'
		END) AS CultureSpecHealing


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '1-Adult Received Financial Assistance'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '2-Unknown Received Financial Assistance'
		END) AS FinAssist


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation'
		END) AS Tspt


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' 
				AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' 
				AND svcs.[Service] NOT IN ('Transportation','Emergency Financial Assistance','Culturally Specific Healing','Restorative Yoga','Sound Healing',
											'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment','Group Counseling','Individual Counseling','Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment','Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment',
											'Crisis Intervention','Art of Healing Workshop','LGBTQ+','RISE','Secondary Survivor','General Advocacy', 'Interpretation')
				THEN '2-Adult Received Other Services'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' 
				AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult')
				AND svcs.[Service] NOT IN ('Transportation','Emergency Financial Assistance','Culturally Specific Healing','Restorative Yoga','Sound Healing',
											'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment','Group Counseling','Individual Counseling','Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment','Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment',
											'Crisis Intervention','Art of Healing Workshop','LGBTQ+','RISE','Secondary Survivor','General Advocacy', 'Interpretation')
				THEN '3-Unknown Received Other Services'
		END) AS OthSvcs

	FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	
	WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
		AND (cp.dob <= DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
			OR pe.ClientType != 'Child')

	GROUP BY cp.document_id, svcs.DateofService
)

SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity

,CASE
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))<=12 THEN '1-0 to 12' 
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17 THEN '2-13 to 17' 
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '3-18 to 24'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 25 AND 49 THEN '4-25 to 49'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '5-50 to 59'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))>=60 THEN '6-60+'
	WHEN MAX(sv.Client_Type) = '1-Adult' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '7-Unknown Adult Age'
	WHEN MAX(sv.Client_Type) = '2-Child/Youth' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '8-Unknown Child Age' 
	ELSE '9-Unknown/Not Reported' 
END AS Age_Group

,MAX(sv.Gender) AS Gender
,MAX(sv.Client_Type) AS Client_Type
,MAX(sv.Disabled_SelfID) AS Disabled_SelfID
,MAX(sv.LGBTQ_SelfID) AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,MAX(sv.Vic_AdultSA) AS Vic_AdultSA
,MAX(sv.Vic_ChildhoodSA) AS Vic_ChildhoodSA
,MAX(sv.Secondary_Survivor) AS Secondary_Survivor
,MAX(sv.Vic_Oth) AS Other_Victimization
,MAX(sv.Rel_Partner) AS Rel_Partner
,MAX(sv.Rel_Family) AS Rel_Family
,MAX(sv.Rel_Dating) AS Rel_Dating
,MAX(sv.Rel_Acq) AS Rel_Acquaintance
,MAX(sv.Rel_Stranger) AS Rel_Stranger
,MAX(sv.Rel_UnrOth) AS Rel_UnknownOther
,MAX(sv.ReferralSource) AS ReferredFrom
,CAST(s.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,s.Lang_Svcs AS Lang_Svcs
,s.GenAdv AS General_Advocacy
,s.MedAdv AS Medical_Advocacy
,s.Groups AS SA_Groups
,s.Crisis_Intervention AS Crisis_Intervention
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Counseling AS Counseling
,s.Healing AS Holistic_Healing
,s.CultureSpecHealing AS Culturally_Spec_Healing
,s.FinAssist AS Financial_Assistance
,s.Tspt AS Transportation
,s.OthSvcs AS Other_Svcs

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	INNER JOIN dv.vw_DES_SV_01_clients cs ON cp.document_id=cs.Client_ProfileID
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_sv_nonSvcs sv ON (sv.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_Svcs s ON (s.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)



GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,cp.dob
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,s.DateofService
,s.Lang_Svcs
,s.GenAdv
,s.MedAdv
,s.Groups
,s.Crisis_Intervention
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Counseling
,s.Healing
,s.CultureSpecHealing
,s.FinAssist
,s.Tspt
,s.OthSvcs

,svcs.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Female' THEN '1-Adult Female'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender = 'Male' THEN '2-Adult Male'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender LIKE 'A gender other than singularly female or male%' THEN '3-Adult Non-binary'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND cp.gender IN ('Transgender', 'Questioning', 'Client Doesn''t Know', 'Client refused', 'Data not collected') THEN '4-Not Specified/Other'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Unknown' THEN '4-Not Specified/Other' 
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Gender
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '0-Child/Youth'
END AS Client_Type
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%LGBTQ%' THEN '1-Self-Identified as LGBTQ'
END AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND (pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Deaf/Hard of Hearing%'
			OR pe.ClientSpecialClassification LIKE '%Victims with Disabilities: Cognitive/Physical/Mental%') THEN '1-Self-Identified as Disabled'
END AS Disabled_SelfID
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult'
		AND (pe.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Assault%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Sexual Harassment%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Sex Trafficked%') THEN '1-Adult Victim of SA and/or SV'
END AS Vic_AdultSA
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult'
		AND pe.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Survivor of Child SA%' OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Adult Victim of Child SA%' THEN '1-Adult Victim of Childhood SA and/or SV'
END AS Vic_ChildhoodSA
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult', 'Unknown')
		AND pe.AbuseStatus = 'Secondary Victim' THEN '1-Secondary Survivor'
END AS Secondary_Survivor
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult', 'Unknown')
		AND (pe.VictimType LIKE '%Stalking%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Domestic Violence%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Child SA%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Labor Trafficked%'
			OR pe.VictimType LIKE '%Homeless%'
			OR pe.VictimType IN ('Other')
			OR pe.VictimType IS NULL) THEN '1-Other Victimization'
END AS Vic_Oth
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Current or Former Spouse or Intimate Partner%' THEN '1-Current or Former Partner'
END AS Rel_Partner
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Other Family or Household Member%' THEN '1-Other Family or Household Member'
END AS Rel_Family
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Current or Former Dating Relationship%' THEN '1-Current or Former Dating Relationship'
END AS Rel_Dating
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Acquaintance%' THEN '1-Acquaintance'
END AS Rel_Acq
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Stranger%' THEN '1-Stranger'
END AS Rel_Stranger
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'
		AND pe.AbuseStatus NOT IN ('Secondary Victim', 'Other')
		AND (pe.RelationshiptoAbuser LIKE '%Relationship Unknown%' 
			OR pe.RelationshiptoAbuser IN ('Other')
			OR pe.RelationshiptoAbuser NOT IN ('Current or Former Spouse or Intimate Partner', 'Other Family or Household Member', 'Current or Former Dating Relationship', 'Acquaintance', 'Stranger')
			OR pe.RelationshiptoAbuser IS NULL) THEN '1-Unknown/Other'
END AS Rel_UnrOth
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Social Media', 'Agency Website') THEN '1-Internet/Website'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Family/Friend') THEN '2-Family/Friend/Acquaintance'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Social Services', 'Family Advocacy Center') THEN '3-Social Service Agency'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Police Department', 'Prosecutor/Attorney') THEN '4-Criminal Justice Agency'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus IN ('Medical', 'Mental Health', 'Medical Advocacy') THEN '5-Medical/Healthcare Provider'
	ELSE '6-Unknown/Other'
END AS ReferralSource

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.ANL_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND (cp.dob <= DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
			OR pe.ClientType != 'Child')
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%'

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,cp.gender
,cp.dob
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,pe.ClientType
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.VictimType
,pe.AbuseStatus
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser
,pe.EnrollmentStatus
,pe.HowdidSVHelplineCallerhearaboutus
,svcs.RecordID
,svcs.ProgramEnrollment
,svcs.DateofService
),

cte_Svcs AS (

SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
	,svcs.DateofService
	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Interpretation') THEN '1-Received Interpretation'
		END) AS Lang_Svcs


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy') THEN '2-Adult Received General Advocacy'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('General Advocacy') THEN '3-Unknown Received General Advocacy'
		END) AS GenAdv


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS MedAdv


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '2-Adult Attended SA Specific Groups'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Art of Healing Workshop', 'LGBTQ+', 'RISE', 'Secondary Survivor') THEN '3-Unknown Attended SA Specific Groups'
		END) AS Groups


	,MAX(CASE
		
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '2-Adult Received Crisis Intervention'
		WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Crisis Intervention') THEN '3-Unknown Received Crisis Intervention'
	END) AS Crisis_Intervention


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Adult Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '2-Unknown Received Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment'
		END) AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling') THEN '2-Adult Attended Counseling'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[ServiceCategory] IN ('Counseling') THEN '3-Unknown Attended Counseling'
		END) AS Counseling


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Holistic Healing'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Restorative Yoga', 'Sound Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Holistic Healing'
		END) AS Healing


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '2-Adult Received Culturally Specific Healing'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Culturally Specific Healing') THEN '3-Unknown Received Culturally Specific Healing'
		END) AS CultureSpecHealing


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '1-Adult Received Financial Assistance'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Emergency Financial Assistance') THEN '2-Unknown Received Financial Assistance'
		END) AS FinAssist


	,MAX(CASE
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '1-Adult Received Transportation'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult') AND svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation') THEN '2-Unknown Received Transportation'
		END) AS Tspt


	,MAX(CASE
			
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' 
				AND pe.ClientType = 'Adult' 
				AND svcs.[Service] NOT IN ('Transportation','Emergency Financial Assistance','Culturally Specific Healing','Restorative Yoga','Sound Healing',
											'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment','Group Counseling','Individual Counseling','Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment','Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment',
											'Crisis Intervention','Art of Healing Workshop','LGBTQ+','RISE','Secondary Survivor','General Advocacy', 'Interpretation')
				THEN '2-Adult Received Other Services'
			WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' 
				AND pe.ClientType NOT IN ('Child', 'Adult')
				AND svcs.[Service] NOT IN ('Transportation','Emergency Financial Assistance','Culturally Specific Healing','Restorative Yoga','Sound Healing',
											'Medical Advocacy/Accompaniment','Group Counseling','Individual Counseling','Criminal Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment','Civil Legal Advocacy/Accompaniment',
											'Crisis Intervention','Art of Healing Workshop','LGBTQ+','RISE','Secondary Survivor','General Advocacy', 'Interpretation')
				THEN '3-Unknown Received Other Services'
		END) AS OthSvcs

	FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	
	WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
		AND (cp.dob <= DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
			OR pe.ClientType != 'Child')

	GROUP BY cp.document_id, svcs.DateofService
)

SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity

,CASE
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))<=12 THEN '1-0 to 12' 
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 13 AND 17 THEN '2-13 to 17' 
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN '3-18 to 24'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 25 AND 49 THEN '4-25 to 49'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '5-50 to 59'
	WHEN CONVERT(INT,CAST((DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME, cp.dob),CAST(cs.MonthServed AS DATE))/365.24) AS DECIMAL(10,2)))>=60 THEN '6-60+'
	WHEN MAX(sv.Client_Type) = '1-Adult' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '7-Unknown Adult Age'
	WHEN MAX(sv.Client_Type) = '2-Child/Youth' AND (cp.dob IS NULL OR cp.dob = '') THEN '8-Unknown Child Age' 
	ELSE '9-Unknown/Not Reported' 
END AS Age_Group

,MAX(sv.Gender) AS Gender
,MAX(sv.Client_Type) AS Client_Type
,MAX(sv.Disabled_SelfID) AS Disabled_SelfID
,MAX(sv.LGBTQ_SelfID) AS LGBTQ_SelfID
,MAX(sv.Vic_AdultSA) AS Vic_AdultSA
,MAX(sv.Vic_ChildhoodSA) AS Vic_ChildhoodSA
,MAX(sv.Secondary_Survivor) AS Secondary_Survivor
,MAX(sv.Vic_Oth) AS Other_Victimization
,MAX(sv.Rel_Partner) AS Rel_Partner
,MAX(sv.Rel_Family) AS Rel_Family
,MAX(sv.Rel_Dating) AS Rel_Dating
,MAX(sv.Rel_Acq) AS Rel_Acquaintance
,MAX(sv.Rel_Stranger) AS Rel_Stranger
,MAX(sv.Rel_UnrOth) AS Rel_UnknownOther
,MAX(sv.ReferralSource) AS ReferredFrom
,CAST(s.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,s.Lang_Svcs AS Lang_Svcs
,s.GenAdv AS General_Advocacy
,s.MedAdv AS Medical_Advocacy
,s.Groups AS SA_Groups
,s.Crisis_Intervention AS Crisis_Intervention
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy AS Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy AS Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Counseling AS Counseling
,s.Healing AS Holistic_Healing
,s.CultureSpecHealing AS Culturally_Spec_Healing
,s.FinAssist AS Financial_Assistance
,s.Tspt AS Transportation
,s.OthSvcs AS Other_Svcs

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	INNER JOIN dv.vw_DES_SV_01_clients cs ON cp.document_id=cs.Client_ProfileID
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_sv_nonSvcs sv ON (sv.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cte_Svcs s ON (s.Client_ProfileID=cs.Client_ProfileID)



GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,cp.dob
,cp.race
,cp.ethnicity
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,cs.T2_RecordID
,s.DateofService
,s.Lang_Svcs
,s.GenAdv
,s.MedAdv
,s.Groups
,s.Crisis_Intervention
,s.Civil_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Criminal_LegalAdvocacy
,s.Counseling
,s.Healing
,s.CultureSpecHealing
,s.FinAssist
,s.Tspt
,s.OthSvcs

views.name: dvshelter_exceptions
views.sourceSql:
WITH

cte_extended_stay_excpt AS ( 
SELECT 
'Extended Stay' AS Exception
,cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CAST(bed.CheckInDate AS DATE) AS CheckInDate
,CAST(bed.CheckOutDate AS DATE) AS CheckOutDate
,CASE
	WHEN (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(DAY, pe.ServiceEndDate, GETDATE()) >= 120)
		OR (bed.CheckOutDate IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(DAY, bed.CheckOutDate, GETDATE()) >=120) THEN 'Client open >120 days'
	WHEN (DATEDIFF(DAY, pe.ServiceStartDate, pe.ServiceEndDate) >= 120)
		OR (DATEDIFF(DAY, bed.CheckInDate, bed.CheckOutDate) >= 120) THEN 'Client stay >120 days'
END AS Note
FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN BedEnrollment bed ON bed.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')
	AND ((pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(DAY, pe.ServiceEndDate, GETDATE()) >= 120)
		OR (bed.CheckOutDate IS NULL AND DATEDIFF(DAY, bed.CheckOutDate, GETDATE()) >=120)
		OR DATEDIFF(DAY, pe.ServiceStartDate, pe.ServiceEndDate) >= 120
		OR DATEDIFF(DAY, bed.CheckInDate, bed.CheckOutDate) >= 120)
),

cte_bedenrollment_mismatch_excpt AS ( 
SELECT 
'Bed Enrollment Mismatch' AS Exception
,cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CAST(bed.CheckInDate AS DATE) AS CheckInDate
,CAST(bed.CheckOutDate AS DATE) AS CheckOutDate
,CASE
	WHEN bed.CheckInDate < pe.ServiceStartDate THEN 'CheckIn date before program start date'
	
	WHEN bed.CheckOutDate < bed.CheckInDate THEN 'CheckOut date before CheckIn date'
	WHEN bed.CheckOutDate > pe.ServiceEndDate THEN 'CheckOut date after program end date'
END AS Note
FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN BedEnrollment bed ON bed.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')
	AND (bed.CheckInDate < pe.ServiceStartDate 
		OR bed.CheckOutDate < bed.CheckInDate OR bed.CheckOutDate > pe.ServiceEndDate)
)

,cte_missing_checkout_excpt AS ( 
SELECT 
'Missing CheckOut Date' AS Exception
,cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CAST(bed.CheckInDate AS DATE) AS CheckInDate
,CAST(bed.CheckOutDate AS DATE) AS CheckOutDate
,CASE
	WHEN pe.ServiceEndDate IS NOT NULL AND bed.CheckOutDate IS NULL THEN 'Client has program end date but no CheckOut date'
END AS Note
FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN BedEnrollment bed ON bed.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')
	AND (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NOT NULL AND bed.CheckOutDate IS NULL)
)

,cte_missing_PEend_excpt AS ( 
SELECT 
'Missing Program End Date' AS Exception
,cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') AND bed.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CAST(bed.CheckInDate AS DATE) AS CheckInDate
,CAST(bed.CheckOutDate AS DATE) AS CheckOutDate
,CASE
	WHEN pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND bed.CheckOutDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Client has CheckOut date but no program end date'
END AS Note
FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN BedEnrollment bed ON bed.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')
	AND (pe.ServiceEndDate IS NULL AND bed.CheckOutDate IS NOT NULL)
)

,cte_missing_bedenrollment_excpt AS ( 
SELECT 
'Missing Bed Enrollment' AS Exception
,cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CAST(bed.CheckInDate AS DATE) AS CheckInDate
,CAST(bed.CheckOutDate AS DATE) AS CheckOutDate
,CASE
	WHEN pe.ServiceStartDate IS NOT NULL AND bed.CheckInDate IS NULL THEN 'Client is missing bed enrollment'
END AS Note

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
    JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id
    JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID = docs.RecordId
    LEFT JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId = docs.RecordId
    LEFT JOIN BedEnrollment bed ON bed.RecordID = link.LinkFromId
   
WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
    AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')
    AND link.LinkFromId IS NULL
)

SELECT * FROM cte_extended_stay_excpt
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_bedenrollment_mismatch_excpt
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_missing_checkout_excpt
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_missing_PEend_excpt
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_missing_bedenrollment_excpt

WHERE [Program_Name] IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP', 'Faith House', 'Faith House Transitional')

views.sourceSql:
WITH 
cte_ovw_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CASE
	WHEN pe.OVWClientServedStatus IS NOT NULL AND pe.OVWClientServedStatus != '' THEN pe.OVWClientServedStatus
	ELSE NULL
END AS OVWClientServedStatus
,pe.RecordID AS pe_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.State_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.State_MStart) 

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test' 
	AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline')
	AND pe.AbuseStatus IN ('Primary Victim') 
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%'
	AND svcs.Funder = 'OVW-Late Life' 

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE)
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE)
,pe.OVWClientServedStatus
,pe.RecordID
),

RankedData AS (
SELECT ovw.Client_ProfileID
,ovw.client_name
,ovw.Fiscal_Year
,ovw.[Quarter]
,ovw.MonthServed
,ovw.[Program_Name]
,ovw.ServiceStartDate
,ovw.ServiceEndDate
,ovw.first_service
,ovw.OVWClientServedStatus
,ovw.pe_RecordID
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
					PARTITION BY ovw.Client_ProfileID, ovw.Fiscal_Year 
					ORDER BY ovw.first_service 
					) AS RowNum 
FROM cte_ovw_clients ovw
)
SELECT rd.Client_ProfileID
,rd.client_name
,rd.Fiscal_Year
,rd.[Quarter]
,rd.MonthServed
,rd.[Program_Name]
,rd.ServiceStartDate
,rd.ServiceEndDate
,rd.first_service
,rd.OVWClientServedStatus
,rd.pe_RecordID

FROM RankedData rd
WHERE RowNum = 1

views.sourceSql:
WITH
cte_ovw_NonSVCS AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN pe.[Program] = 'DVSTOP' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,pe.ClientType
,pe.VictimType
,pe.RelationshiptoAbuser
,pe.ClientSpecialClassification
,pe.ExitDestination
,CASE
	WHEN pe.OVWClientServedStatus IS NOT NULL AND pe.OVWClientServedStatus != '' THEN pe.OVWClientServedStatus
	ELSE NULL
END AS OVWClientServedStatus
,pe.RecordID AS pe_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId

WHERE pe.[Program] = 'DVSTOP'
)


SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,cs.[Program_Name]
,cs.Fiscal_Year
,cs.[Quarter]
,cs.MonthServed
,cs.first_service
,cs.ServiceStartDate
,cs.ServiceEndDate
,CASE
	WHEN cs.OVWClientServedStatus = 'Client Fully Served' THEN '1-Fully Served'
	WHEN cs.OVWClientServedStatus = 'Client Partially Served' THEN '2-Partially Served'
	ELSE '3-Unknown/Not Reported'
END AS OVWClientServedStatus
,cs.pe_RecordID
,CASE
	WHEN cp.disability IS NOT NULL THEN '1-Disabled' 
	ELSE '0-Unknown/Not Reported'
END AS disability
,CASE
	WHEN cp.race = 'American Indian or Alaska Native' AND cp.ethnicity != 'Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)' THEN '1-American Indian or Alaska Native'
	WHEN cp.race = 'Asian' AND cp.ethnicity != 'Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)' THEN '2-Asian'
	WHEN cp.race = 'Black or African American' AND cp.ethnicity != 'Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)' THEN '3-Black or African American'
	WHEN cp.race = 'Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander' AND cp.ethnicity != 'Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)' THEN '4-Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander'
	WHEN cp.race = 'White' AND cp.ethnicity != 'Hispanic/Latin(a)(o)(x)' THEN '5-White'

views.sourceSql:
WITH
cte_ovw_svcs AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,svcs.InHours AS Hrs
,svcs.ServiceCategory
,svcs.[Service]
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.AdditionalServiceDetail IN ('Culturally Specific Healing', '125570003') THEN 'E-Culturally specific services'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] LIKE 'Medical Forensic Exam%' OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Victim Advocacy/Accompaniment to Medical Forensic Exam' THEN 'G-Forensic exam'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] LIKE 'Medical Advocacy%' OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Emergency Medical Care' THEN 'H-Hospital/clinic/other medical response'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] IN ('Interpretation') OR svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Interpretation' OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Interpreter Services' THEN 'I-Language services'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] IN ('Transportation', 'Transportation Assistance', 'Pet Transportation') OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Transportation Assistance' THEN 'J-Transportation'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] IN ('Issued Voucher', 'Hotel Voucher') THEN 'L-Emergency shelter (hotel/motel)'
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Housing & Stability' OR svcs.[Service] IN ('Housing Search Support', 'Housing Advocacy', 'Landlord Coordination', 'Financial Assistance (Housing Stability)', 'Housing Readiness Planning') OR svcs.ShelterHousingServices IN ('Transitional housing', 'Relocation assistance') THEN 'M-Other housing support'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] LIKE 'Civil Legal Ad%' OR svcs.[Service] IN ('Legal Referrals', 'Protective Order Assistance') OR svcs.CriminalCivilJusticeAssistance LIKE 'Civil Legal Assistance%' OR svcs.CriminalCivilJusticeAssistance = 'Immigration Assistance' OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Immigration Assistance' THEN 'A-Civil legal advocacy/court accompaniment'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] LIKE 'Criminal Legal Advocacy%' OR svcs.[Service] = 'Criminal Justice Advocacy/Accompaniment' OR svcs.CriminalCivilJusticeAssistance IN ('Notification of Criminal Justice Events', 'Victim Impact Statement Assistance', 'Assistance with Restitution', 'Other Emergency Justice-Related Assistance', 'Prosecution Interview Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Law Enforcement Interview Advocacy/Accompaniment', 'Criminal Advocacy/Accompaniment') OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Law Enforcement Interview Advocacy/Accompaniment' THEN 'C-Criminal Justice Advocacy/court accompaniment'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] = 'Crisis Intervention' OR svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices IN ('Crisis intervention (in-person, includes safety planning, etc.)', 'Hotline/crisis line counseling', 'On-scene crisis response (e.g., community crisis response)') THEN 'D-Crisis intervention'
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory IN ('Groups', 'Counseling') OR svcs.[Service] IN ('Emotional Support', 'Counseling Referral', 'Support Groups', 'Coping Skills Development', 'Indivdual Counseling', 'Group Registration') OR svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices IN ('Individual counseling', 'Support Groups (facilitated or peer)', 'Other therapy (traditional, culturalm or alternative healing: art, writing, or play therapy, etc.)') THEN 'B-Counseling/support group'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] IN ('Budgeting Support', 'Financial Literacy', 'Benefits Navigation', 'Emergency Financial Assistance') OR svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices LIKE 'Emergency financial assistance%' THEN 'F-Information provided on economic matters'
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Other' OR svcs.[Service] = 'Other' THEN 'N-Other'
	ELSE 'K-Victim/survivor advocacy'
END AS OVW_Services
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'OVW Client Assistance' THEN '0-' + svcs.[Service]
END AS OVW_ClientAssistance
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'OVW Client Assistance' THEN svcs.ServiceCost
END AS ServiceCost
,svcs.RecordID AS svcs_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name != 'Test'
	AND svcs.Funder = 'OVW-Late Life'
	AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline')
)

SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM cte_ovw_svcs ovwSvcs
WHERE ovwSvcs.[Program_Name] IS NOT NULL

'Criminal Advocacy/Accompaniment') OR svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment = 'Law Enforcement Interview Advocacy/Accompaniment' THEN 'C-Criminal Justice Advocacy/court accompaniment' WHEN svcs."Service" = 'Crisis Intervention' OR svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices IN ('Crisis intervention (in-person, includes safety planning, etc.)', 'Hotline/crisis line counseling', 'On-scene crisis response Groups', 'Coping Skills Development', 'Indivdual Counseling', 'Group Registration') OR svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices IN ('Individual counseling', 'Support Groups (facilitated or peer)', 'Other therapy (traditional, culturalm or alternative healing: art, writing, or play therapy, etc.)') THEN 'B-Counseling/support group' WHEN svcs."Service" IN ('Budgeting Support', 'Financial Literacy', svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Other' OR svcs."Service" = 'Other' THEN 'N-Other' ELSE 'K-Victim/survivor advocacy' END AS OVW_Services, CASE WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'OVW Client Assistance' THEN '0-' || svcs."Service" END AS OVW_ClientAssistance, CASE WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'OVW Client Assistance' THEN svcs.ServiceCost END AS ServiceCost, svcs.RecordID AS svcs_RecordID FROM base_Client_Profile AS cp JOIN base_documents AS docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id JOIN base_ProgramEnrollment AS pe ON pe.RecordID = docs.RecordId JOIN base_Links AS link ON link.LinkToId = docs.RecordId JOIN WITH cte_shelter_exits AS (
SELECT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CAST(CASE
	
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House' 
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional' 
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('DVSTOP') AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') THEN 'DVSTOP'
	WHEN pe.[Program] IN ('CAAFA Outreach') AND pe.ServiceSite LIKE '%Crisis Response' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach' 
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name] 
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,CASE
	WHEN pe.DischargeStatus IN ('Positive') THEN '1-Positive Exit'
	WHEN pe.DischargeStatus IN ('Negative') THEN '2-Negative Exit'
	WHEN pe.DischargeStatus NOT IN ('Positive', 'Negative') AND pe.ServiceEndDate IS NOT NULL THEN '3-Unknown Exit'
	ELSE NULL
END AS exit_status
,CASE
	WHEN pe.SafeLoc = 'Yes' THEN '1-Safe Exit/Placement'
	WHEN pe.SafeLoc = 'No' THEN '2-Unsafe Exit/Placement'
	ELSE '3-Unknown Exit/Placement'
END AS loc_status

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
)
SELECT *
FROM cte_shelter_exits

WHERE [Program_Name] IS NOT NULL AND ServiceEndDate IS NOT NULL

WITH 
cte_shelter_clients AS ( 

SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,MIN(ref.ANL_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House' 
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional' 
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MAX(CASE
	WHEN pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '2-Child'
	ELSE '3-Unknown'
END) AS Client_Type

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND ISNULL(pe.ServiceEndDate, GETDATE()) >= ref.ANL_MStart) 
WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'Faith House', 'DVSTOP')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CASE
	
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Autumn House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('CAAFA Shelter') THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('Faith House') AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
	WHEN pe.Program IN ('DVSTOP') THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
),

cte_outreachANDsv_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,MIN(ref.ANL_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MAX(CASE
	WHEN pe.ClientType = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult'
	WHEN pe.ClientType = 'Child' THEN '2-Child'
	ELSE '3-Unknown'
END) AS Client_Type

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.ANL_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.ANL_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test' 
		AND (svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%')

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
END
),

cte_agg_clients AS (
SELECT *
FROM cte_shelter_clients dv

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM cte_outreachANDsv_clients osv
)

SELECT agg.Client_ProfileID
,agg.Fiscal_Year
,agg.[Quarter]
,agg.MonthServed
,agg.[Program_Name]
,agg.Client_Type

FROM cte_agg_clients agg

WITH

			CASE

views.name: sage_01_receiving

WITH 
cte_sage_clients_receiving AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS svcs_RecordID
,pe.ClientType

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.State_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.State_MStart) 

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing')
	AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline')
	AND (svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' 
		OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%')
	AND svcs.Funder IN ('VOCA', 'OVW-Late Life') 

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID
,pe.ClientType
),

RankedData AS (
SELECT agg.Client_ProfileID
,agg.Fiscal_Year
,agg.[Quarter]
,agg.MonthServed
,agg.[Program_Name]
,agg.first_service
,agg.ServiceStartDate
,agg.ServiceEndDate
,agg.svcs_RecordID
,agg.ClientType
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
					PARTITION BY agg.Client_ProfileID, agg.[Program_Name], agg.Fiscal_Year 
					ORDER BY agg.first_service 
					) AS RowNum 
FROM cte_sage_clients_receiving agg
)

SELECT rd.Client_ProfileID
,rd.Fiscal_Year
,rd.[Quarter]
,rd.MonthServed
,rd.[Program_Name]
,rd.first_service
,rd.ServiceStartDate
,rd.ServiceEndDate
,rd.svcs_RecordID 
,rd.ClientType

FROM RankedData rd
WHERE RowNum = 1

WITH

	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,svcs.InHours AS Hrs
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Personal Advocacy/Accompaniment') AND svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Victim Advocacy' THEN '1-Personal Advocacy' 
	ELSE NULL
END AS PersonalAdv 
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Information and Referral') AND svcs.InformationandReferral LIKE 'Referral%' THEN '1-Referral'
	ELSE NULL
END AS Referrals
,CASE
	WHEN (svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Emotional Support or Safety Services') AND svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices IN ('Individual counseling')) OR svcs.[Service] = 'Individual Counseling' THEN '1-Counseling' 
	ELSE NULL
END AS IndvCounseling
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Emotional Support or Safety Services') AND svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices LIKE 'Support Group%' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult') THEN '1-Adult Support Group'
	WHEN svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Emotional Support or Safety Services') AND svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices LIKE 'Support Group%' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '1-Child Support Group'
	ELSE NULL
END AS SuppGroups
,CASE
	WHEN ((svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Emotional Support or Safety Services') AND svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices LIKE 'Crisis intervention%') OR (svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning')) AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult') THEN '1-Adult Safety Planning' 
	WHEN ((svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Emotional Support or Safety Services') AND svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices LIKE 'Crisis intervention%') OR (svcs.[Service] LIKE '%Safety Planning')) AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '1-Child Safety Planning'	
	ELSE NULL
END AS SafetyPlan
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Personal Advocacy/Accompaniment') AND svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment IN ('Transportation Assistance') THEN '1-Transport'
	ELSE NULL
END AS Transportation
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.[Service] = 'Issued Voucher' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult') THEN '1-Adult Hotel Night'
	WHEN svcs.[Service] = 'Issued Voucher' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '1-Child Hotel Night'
	ELSE NULL
END AS HotelNight
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Assessment' AND svcs.[Service] = 'Adult' THEN '1-Adult Assessment'
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Assessment' AND svcs.[Service] = 'Child' THEN '1-Child Assessment' 
	ELSE NULL 
END AS Assessment
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Intake and Discharge' AND svcs.[Service] = 'Intake' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Adult') THEN '1-Adult Intake'
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'Intake and Discharge' AND svcs.[Service] = 'Intake' AND pe.ClientType IN ('Child') THEN '1-Child Intake'
	ELSE NULL
END AS Intake
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory IN ('Case Management', 'Intake and Discharge', 'Focus Meeting', 'Crisis Intervention', 'Assessment', 'Pet Services') 
		AND svcs.DirectServiceCategories IN ('Personal Advocacy/Accompaniment') THEN '1-Case Management' 
	ELSE NULL
END AS CaseMgmt
,CASE 
	WHEN svcs.ServiceCategory = 'FOCUS Meeting' THEN '1-Focus Plan' 
	ELSE NULL
END AS FocusPlan
,svcs.RecordID AS svcs_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name != 'Test'
	AND svcs.Funder IN ('VOCA', 'OVW-Late Life') 
	AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') 
	AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') 
)

SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM cte_ss ss
WHERE ss.[Program_Name] IS NOT NULL

views.name: services
views.sourceSql:
WITH
cte_clients_served AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,CAST(cp.dob AS DATE) AS DOB
,cp.race AS Race
,CASE
	WHEN cp.multi_race_ind IN ('Yes', 'No') THEN cp.multi_race_ind
	ELSE NULL 
END AS MultiRaceInd
,cp.gender AS Gender
,cp.ethnicity AS Ethnicity
,cp.mil_veteran AS VeteranStatus
,cp.disability AS DisabilityStatus 
,CAST(CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing')  THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing')  THEN 'Autumn House' 
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing')  THEN 'Faith House Transitional' 
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing')  THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline') THEN 'DVSTOP'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVHEART%' THEN 'DVHEART'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name] 
,MAX(CASE
		WHEN pe.ClientType IN ('Adult', 'Child') THEN pe.ClientType
		ELSE 'Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS ClientType
,MAX(CASE
		WHEN pe.AbuseStatus IN ('Primary Victim', 'Secondary Victim') THEN pe.AbuseStatus
		ELSE 'Unknown/Not Reported' 
	END) AS AbuseStatus
,MAX(CASE
		WHEN pe.ClientSpecialClassification NOT LIKE '%None of the Above%' AND pe.ClientSpecialClassification IS NOT NULL THEN pe.ClientSpecialClassification
		WHEN pe.ClientSpecialClassification = 'None of the Above' THEN 'None of the Above'
		ELSE 'Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS ClientSpecialClassification
,MAX(CASE
		WHEN pe.VictimType IS NOT NULL THEN pe.VictimType
		ELSE 'Unknown/Not Reported'
	END) AS VictimType
,CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE) AS DateOfService
,svcs.ServiceSite
,svcs.InHours AS Hrs
,svcs.ServiceCategory
,svcs.[Service]
,svcs.Wheredidyourefer
,svcs.Funder
,svcs.DirectServiceCategories
,svcs.CriminalCivilJusticeAssistance
,svcs.EmotionalSupportorSafetyServices
,svcs.InformationandReferral
,svcs.PersonalAdvocacyAccompaniment
,svcs.ShelterHousingServices
,svcs.RecordID AS svcs_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId

WHERE cp.last_name != 'Test'
	AND svcs.ProgramEnrollment NOT LIKE 'SVSASS%' 

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,cp.dob
