views.sourceSql:
WITH

cte_unmet_shelter_PE AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS TurnawayDate
,CAST(CASE
    WHEN pe.Program = 'Autumn House' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House'
    WHEN pe.Program = 'Autumn House' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Autumn House Transitional'
    WHEN pe.Program = 'Faith House' AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House'
    WHEN pe.Program = 'Faith House' AND pe.ProjectType IN ('Transitional Housing') THEN 'Faith House Transitional'
    WHEN pe.Program = 'CAAFA Shelter' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
    WHEN pe.Program = 'DVSTOP' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
,pe.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,'1-Unmet Shelter Request' AS Unmet_Shelter
,CASE
	WHEN pe.ReasonTurnedAway IS NULL OR pe.ReasonTurnedAway = '' THEN 'Unknown/Not Reported'
	ELSE pe.ReasonTurnedAway
END AS TurnawayReason
,'Program Enrollment' AS TurnawayOriginIndicator

FROM Client_Profile cp
JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id
JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID = docs.RecordId
JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (pe.ServiceStartDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND pe.ServiceStartDate >= ref.State_MStart)
WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
AND pe.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')
AND pe.EnrollmentStatus = 'Turnaway'
AND pe.ReasonTurnedAway LIKE '%Capacity%'
),

cte_unmet_shelter_helpline AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CAST(hl.DateOfContact AS DATE) AS TurnawayDate
,CAST(CASE
    WHEN hl.Program = 'Autumn House' THEN 'Autumn House'
    WHEN hl.Program = 'Faith House' THEN 'Faith House'
    WHEN hl.Program = 'CAAFA Shelter' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
    WHEN hl.Program = 'DVSTOP' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
,hl.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,'1-Unmet Shelter Request' AS Unmet_Shelter
,CASE
	WHEN hl.HelplineTurnawayReason IS NULL OR hl.HelplineTurnawayReason = '' THEN 'Unknown/Not Reported'
	ELSE hl.HelplineTurnawayReason
END AS TurnawayReason
,'Helpline' AS TurnawayOriginIndicator

FROM Client_Profile cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id
	JOIN Helpline hl ON hl.RecordID = docs.RecordId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (hl.DateOfContact <= ref.State_MEnd AND hl.DateOfContact >= ref.State_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND hl.Program IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')
	AND hl.CallerTurnaway = 'Yes'
	AND hl.HelplineTurnawayReason = 'No Vacancy'
),

cte_unmet_shelter_shelterscreen AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,ref.[Quarter]
,CAST(ss.ScreenDate AS DATE) AS TurnawayDate
,CAST(CASE
    WHEN ss.ProgramScreening = 'Autumn House' THEN 'Autumn House'
    WHEN ss.ProgramScreening = 'Faith House' THEN 'Faith House'
    WHEN ss.ProgramScreening = 'CAAFA Shelter' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
    WHEN ss.ProgramScreening = 'DVSTOP' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS nvarchar(100)) AS [Program_Name]
,ss.RecordID AS T2_RecordID
,'1-Unmet Shelter Request' AS Unmet_Shelter
,CASE
	WHEN ss.ShelterTurnawayReason IS NULL OR ss.ShelterTurnawayReason = '' THEN 'Unknown/Not Reported'
	ELSE ss.ShelterTurnawayReason
END AS TurnawayReason
,'Shelter Screening' AS TurnawayOriginIndicator

FROM Client_Profile cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId = cp.document_id
	JOIN ShelterScreening ss ON ss.RecordID = docs.RecordId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (ss.ScreenDate <= ref.State_MEnd AND ss.ScreenDate >= ref.State_MStart)

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND ss.ProgramScreening IN ('Autumn House', 'Faith House', 'CAAFA Shelter', 'DVSTOP')
	AND ss.PlacedInShelter = 'No'
	AND (ss.ShelterTurnawayReason IN ('Household composition restrictions', 'Accessibility needs unable to be met') OR ss.ShelterTurnawayReason LIKE '%turned away%' OR ss.ShelterTurnawayReason ='') 
),

cte_unmet_shelter AS (
SELECT * FROM cte_unmet_shelter_PE
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_unmet_shelter_helpline
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cte_unmet_shelter_shelterscreen
),

cte_unmet_shelter_agg AS (
SELECT Client_ProfileID
,Fiscal_Year
,[Quarter]
,TurnawayDate
,[Program_Name]
,Unmet_Shelter
,TurnawayReason
,TurnawayOriginIndicator

FROM cte_unmet_shelter

GROUP BY Client_ProfileID
,Fiscal_Year
,[Quarter]
,TurnawayDate
,[Program_Name]
,Unmet_Shelter
,TurnawayReason
,TurnawayOriginIndicator
)

SELECT *
FROM cte_unmet_shelter_agg

WITH 
cte_voca_clients AS ( 
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_ProfileID
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,MIN(ref.[Quarter]) AS [Quarter]
,MIN(ref.State_MStart) AS MonthServed
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END AS [Program_Name]
,MIN(CAST(svcs.DateofService AS DATE)) AS first_service
,CAST(pe.ServiceStartDate AS DATE) AS ServiceStartDate
,CAST(pe.ServiceEndDate AS DATE) AS ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID AS svcs_RecordID
,pe.RecordID AS pe_RecordID

FROM Client_Profile AS cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN [Services] svcs ON svcs.RecordID=LinkFromId
	JOIN Ref_Dates ref ON (svcs.DateofService <= ref.State_MEnd AND svcs.DateofService >= ref.State_MStart) 

WHERE cp.last_name NOT LIKE 'Test'
	AND pe.ProjectType NOT IN ('Transitional Housing')
	AND pe.ProgramType NOT IN ('Hotline')
	AND (svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' 
		OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' OR svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%')
	AND svcs.Funder IN ('VOCA', 'OVW-Late Life') 

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,ref.Fiscal_Year
,CASE
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Outreach%' THEN 'CAAFA Outreach'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'REACH Center%' THEN 'REACH Center'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Autumn House%' THEN 'Autumn House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'Faith House%' THEN 'Faith House'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'CAAFA Shelter%' THEN 'CAAFA Shelter'
	WHEN svcs.ProgramEnrollment LIKE 'DVSTOP%' THEN 'DVSTOP'
END
,pe.ServiceStartDate
,pe.ServiceEndDate
,svcs.RecordID
,pe.RecordID
),

RankedData AS (
SELECT agg.Client_ProfileID
,agg.Fiscal_Year
,agg.[Quarter]
,agg.MonthServed
,agg.[Program_Name]
,agg.first_service
,agg.ServiceStartDate
,agg.ServiceEndDate
,agg.svcs_RecordID
,agg.pe_RecordID
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
					PARTITION BY agg.Client_ProfileID, agg.[Program_Name], agg.Fiscal_Year 
					ORDER BY agg.first_service 
					) AS RowNum 
FROM cte_voca_clients agg
)

SELECT rd.Client_ProfileID
,rd.Fiscal_Year
,rd.[Quarter]
,rd.MonthServed
,rd.[Program_Name]
,rd.first_service
,rd.ServiceStartDate
,rd.ServiceEndDate
,rd.svcs_RecordID 
,rd.pe_RecordID

FROM RankedData rd
WHERE RowNum = 1

WITH

cte_new_VOCA_clients AS (
SELECT DISTINCT cp.document_id AS Client_RecordID
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name AS client_name
,pe.Program
,pe.RecordID AS peRecID

,MAX(vf.RecordID) AS voca_ID
,MAX(vf.CreationDate) AS last_VOCA_linkDate
,MAX(
	CASE
		WHEN vf.VOCAAgeatTimeofVictimization IS NOT NULL AND vf.VOCAAgeatTimeofVictimization NOT IN ('Not Reported', 'Not Tracked') THEN vf.VOCAAgeatTimeofVictimization
		WHEN vf.VOCAAgeatTimeofVictimization IN ('Not Reported', 'Not Tracked') THEN 'Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE 'No VOCA Form'
	END) AS VOCAAgeatTimeofVictimization
,MAX(
	CASE
		WHEN vf.VOCARaceEthnicity IS NOT NULL AND vf.VOCARaceEthnicity NOT IN ('Not Reported', 'Not Tracked') THEN vf.VOCARaceEthnicity
		WHEN vf.VOCARaceEthnicity IN ('Not Reported', 'Not Tracked') THEN 'Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE 'No VOCA Form'
	END) AS VOCARaceEthnicity
,MAX(
	CASE
		WHEN vf.VOCAVictimizationType IS NOT NULL AND vf.VOCAVictimizationType NOT IN ('Not Reported', 'Not Tracked') THEN vf.VOCAVictimizationType
		WHEN vf.VOCAVictimizationType IN ('Not Reported', 'Not Tracked') THEN 'Unknown/Not Reported'
		ELSE 'No VOCA Form'
	END) AS VOCAVictimizationType
FROM Client_Profile cp
	JOIN documents docs ON docs.ParentId=cp.document_id
	JOIN [VOCAForm] vf ON vf.RecordID=docs.RecordId
	JOIN Links link ON link.LinkToId=docs.RecordId
	JOIN ProgramEnrollment pe ON pe.RecordID=LinkFromId

GROUP BY cp.document_id
,cp.first_name + ' ' + cp.last_name
,pe.Program
,pe.RecordID
)

	WHEN cp.gender IN ('Female') THEN '0-Female'

	WHEN pe.VictimCompensation LIKE '%Victim Qualified%' AND pe.VictimCompensation NOT LIKE '%Victim Not Qualified%' THEN '1-Received Victim Compensation Assistance'
	WHEN pe.VictimCompensation LIKE '%Provided Information%' AND pe.VictimCompensation NOT LIKE '%Victim Qualified%' THEN '2-Received Information About Victim Compensation'

,pe.RecordID
)

fields.name: Bednights
fields.expression:
=IIF(
  (Fields!CheckInDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckInDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value) AND
  (Fields!CheckOutDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value), DateDiff("d", Fields!CheckInDate.Value, Fields!CheckOutDate.Value),

  IIF(
    Fields!CheckInDate.Value < Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value AND
    (Fields!CheckOutDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value), DateDiff("d", Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value, Fields!CheckOutDate.Value),

    IIF(
      (Fields!CheckInDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckInDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value) AND
      (IsNothing(Fields!CheckOutDate.Value) OR Fields!CheckOutDate.Value > Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value),  DateDiff("d", Fields!CheckInDate.Value, DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)),

      IIF(
        Fields!CheckInDate.Value < Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value AND IsNothing(Fields!CheckOutDate.Value), DateDiff("d", Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value, DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)),

        IIF(
          Fields!CheckInDate.Value < Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value > Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value, DateDiff("d", Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value, DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)),

          0
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

fields.name: Bednights
fields.expression:
=IIF(
    Fields!CheckInDate.Value >= DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value) OR
    (Not IsNothing(Fields!CheckOutDate.Value) AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value),
    0,
    DateDiff(
        "d",
        IIF(
            Fields!CheckInDate.Value > Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value,
            Fields!CheckInDate.Value,
            Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value
        ),
        IIF(
            IsNothing(Fields!CheckOutDate.Value),
            DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value),
            IIF(
                Fields!CheckOutDate.Value < DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value),
                Fields!CheckOutDate.Value,
                DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)
            )
        )
    )
)

=IIF(
  (Fields!CheckInDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckInDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value) AND
  (Fields!CheckOutDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value), DateDiff("d", Fields!CheckInDate.Value, Fields!CheckOutDate.Value),

  IIF(
    Fields!CheckInDate.Value < Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value AND
    (Fields!CheckOutDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value), DateDiff("d", Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value, Fields!CheckOutDate.Value),

    IIF(
      (Fields!CheckInDate.Value <= Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value AND Fields!CheckInDate.Value >= Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value) AND
      (IsNothing(Fields!CheckOutDate.Value) OR Fields!CheckOutDate.Value > Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value),  DateDiff("d", Fields!CheckInDate.Value, DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)),

      IIF(
        Fields!CheckInDate.Value < Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value AND IsNothing(Fields!CheckOutDate.Value), DateDiff("d", Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value, DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)),

        IIF(
          Fields!CheckInDate.Value < Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value AND Fields!CheckOutDate.Value > Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value, DateDiff("d", Parameters!ReportPeriodStart.Value, DateAdd("d", 1, Parameters!ReportPeriodEnd.Value)),

          0
        )
      )
    )

)
